descriptions.w3d_d29g_earthquake_start_80061a80: Earthquake effect start: asserts the type is not one of the two world entity types, subscribes a message into +32, copies Earthquake.CameraShakeMagnitude and Earthquake.Length into the camera shake properties and sets Camera.Orbit.IgnoreInput, starts the Orbit sound, posts a message, reads the shake handle into +40 and fades with alpha from magnitude times 200 clamped to 255 over 1000 ms.
